age.evidence: Adult (8 -10 weeks) C57BL/6J and TRAP2 ... male mice were used.

sex.evidence: Adult (8 -10 weeks) C57BL/6J and TRAP2 ... male mice were used.

dosing.doses_raw: 1 mg/kg, i.p.; local mPFC infusion 5 ng or 50 ng
dosing.evidence: Psilocin was solubilized in a mixture of DMSO and normal saline. The test substances were administered intraperitoneally ((i.p.) at a volume of 8 mL/kg. ... microinjection of saline or psilocin (5 ng or 50 ng) into the target brain region.

handling.evidence: mice were allowed to move freely in the test cage for 1 h and were handled for 0.5 h daily to acclimate to the experimental environment and procedures.

assays.assay_description: HTR events were counted from video recordings of freely moving mice in a test cage after systemic i.p. psilocin (1 mg/kg), local mPFC/OFC/IPAC/DMS cannula infusion of psilocin (5 or 50 ng), or during optogenetic activation/inhibition of c-Fos-TRAPed mPFC neurons. Scored by two blinded observers.

application_type.evidence: Systemic i.p. injection of psilocin (1 mg/kg) and local microinjection into mPFC/OFC/IPAC/DMS (5 ng or 50 ng).

setup_habituation.evidence: During the adaptation period, mice were allowed to move freely in the test cage for 1 h ... In the final 3 days of the adaptation period, mice were acclimated to the injector cannula insertion for 20 min daily.

setup_restrain.evidence: mice were allowed to move freely in the test cage

food_restriction.evidence: Test cage HTR assay; no food present in apparatus during recording.

water_restriction.evidence: Test cage HTR assay; no water present in apparatus during recording.

time_to_assay.evidence: A camera mounted above the cage recorded the mice for the next 10 min after the microinjection ... HTR was assessed for 5 min with the laser off (baseline measure), then 5 min with the light on.

sample_size.evidence: mPFC, n = 9 mice, OFC, n = 7 mice, DMS, n = 6 mice, IPAC, n = 5 mice ... n = 9 mice per group (activation) ... n = 8 mice per group (inhibition)

outcomes.summary: Local infusion of psilocin into the mPFC (5 ng or 50 ng) significantly induced HTR, whereas infusion into OFC, IPAC, or DMS did not. Optogenetic activation of c-Fos-TRAPed mPFC neurons in TRAP2 mice produced spontaneous HTR (most robust at 5 Hz), while optogenetic inhibition reduced psilocin-induced HTR by ~two-thirds.
outcomes.statistics: Paired t test; ** p < 0.01, *** p < 0.001, **** p < 0.0001; activation n=9; inhibition n=8.
outcomes.evidence: only localized infusion of psilocin into the mPFC induced a significant HTR ... administration of a minimal dose (5 ng or 25 pmol) of psilocin was sufficient to trigger substantial HTR, while a 10-fold increase in dosage did not significantly elevate the behavioral response ... optogenetic inhibition of c-Fos-positive neurons within the mPFC significantly attenuated psilocin-induced HTR.

B1_num_measures.evidence: video recordings were analyzed by two independent observers ... to count the numbers of HTR.

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: Total HTR counts reported per session; no within-session time-course analysis.

B3_sequential_structure.evidence: Only counts of HTR events reported.

B4_ethological.evidence: HTR is explicitly excluded from ethological behaviours in the rubric.

B5_social.evidence: Mice tested alone in test cage; no social component.

B6_cognitive.evidence: HTR is an innate behavioural response, no learning required.

B7_automated_classification.evidence: video recordings were analyzed by two independent observers, unaware of the treatment conditions, to count the numbers of HTR.

E1_environment_type.evidence: test cage with camera mounted above.

E2_shelter.evidence: Open test cage; no shelter described.

E7_social_context.evidence: Each mouse recorded individually in test cage.

E8_food_water.evidence: Short test cage HTR session; no food/water in apparatus.

D1_continuity.evidence: Optogenetic inhibition experiment: mice received saline injection then 24 h later psilocin injection with HTR assessed; baseline psilocin session 1 week before formal experiment.

D2_session_duration.evidence: Optogenetic inhibition: 1 min laser off / 1 min laser on, repeated 10 times = 20 min total recording session.

D3_recording_days.evidence: Inhibition study: baseline saline day, baseline psilocin day, then formal psilocin + opto day.

D4_baseline.evidence: On the sixth day of the adaptation period, mice received an injection of saline (8 mL/kg, i.p.). Twenty-4 h after the injection of saline, mice received an injection of psilocin (1 mg/kg, i.p.) ... to establish baseline HTR behavior.

D5_followup.evidence: All HTR recordings occurred acutely after psilocin administration.

judge_notes: Single HTR assay across all manipulations (systemic i.p., local cannula infusion into mPFC/OFC/IPAC/DMS, optogenetic activation, optogenetic inhibition) — per rubric, same paradigm under different manipulations = 1 assay.
Excluded c-Fos immunofluorescence quantification (histological endpoint, not behaviour).
D1/D3/D4 scored based on optogenetic inhibition arm, which included a separate baseline psilocin session 1 week prior to formal experiment (explicit baseline HTR measurement).
D2 scored 1 (15-60 min) based on 20-min opto-inhibition session (10 cycles of 1 min off + 1 min on).
B4 = No: HTR is explicitly excluded from ethological behaviours by the rubric.
Vehicle marked 'other' (DMSO + saline mixture); route 'multiple' due to combined systemic and local intracerebral infusion within the same assay.
